title: Fit a useful suggestion inside the typing deadline
description: Change network distance, context size, batching wait, and model tier. The workbench recomputes the complete request path, not model latency in isolation.

scenarios.label: Regional, balanced
scenarios.detail: A nearby region, bounded context, and a balanced serving model.

scenarios.label: Distant user
scenarios.detail: A request crosses a longer network path before inference begins.

scenarios.label: Traffic surge
scenarios.detail: Serving waits longer to form batches while the queue is under pressure.

models.label: Compact model
models.detail: Fastest decoding with a lower illustrative quality ceiling.

models.label: Balanced model
models.detail: Moderate quality, compute, and serving headroom.

models.label: Large model
models.detail: More capacity, but little room for network or queue variance.
